controls: Capabilities receipt must bind HTTP Date, fetch time, final URL and XML SHA.
GetCapabilities, DescribeCoverage and GetCoverage endpoints must each resolve uniquely with approved methods.
Pinned coverage must advertise the expected grid coverage subtype rather than an image-style or hillshade product.
DescribeCoverage boundedBy and native envelope must unambiguously use EPSG:27700.
Grid low/high indices, axis labels and dimension count must agree before subset requests.
Offset vectors must prove orthogonal one-metre grid spacing and expected axis directions.
Range type must expose one usable elevation field with metre unit and no ambiguous alternate bands.
Each request must bind exact unpadded polygon bounds, padded bounds and geometry SHA.
Padding must be the exact finite two-metre contract and applied once in EPSG:27700.
Canonical ordered query bytes and SHA must be recorded before transport.
Production request must not silently route through unapproved proxy environment variables.
Connect, read and total deadlines must be independently bounded and included in failure receipts.
Accepted response requires HTTP 200, approved GeoTIFF media type, bounded length and SHA-256.
Responses must be screened for XML/OGC exception payloads even when the server labels them as binary.
Content-Disposition filename must be optional, safe and consistent with a TIFF response.
Opened raster must contain exactly one elevation band.
CRS, affine transform and all raster bounds must be finite and non-degenerate.
Pixel width and height must equal one metre within a strict documented tolerance.
Affine transform must be north-up and unrotated unless an explicitly supported grid contract is proven.
Nodata metadata, mask band and finite-value screening must agree for every sampled cell.
Primary extrema must use explicit pixel-centre point-in-polygon membership, not Rasterio Bresenham side effects.
Every accepted cell must retain row, column, centre coordinates, raw value and identity hash.
Each target needs a positive bounded strict-centre pixel count and diagnostic mask disagreement count.
Min, max and quantiles must be computed from finite float64 physical values before presentation rounding.
Quantile method and NumPy version must be pinned and included in the sample receipt.
Rows must identify the exact cells producing raw minimum and maximum values.
Each row must bind canonical request SHA, response TIFF SHA and exact HMLR geometry SHA.
Sample output must enforce an exact schema and reject unknown safety-critical fields.
EA output must include one run_id with stage start/end timestamps and bounded duration.
Transport, parse, sampling or timeout failure must quarantine partial TIFF and prior stable output.
